steps.name: Traces of a Rift (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Jade] in the "Infinite Corridor", then find the [Rooftop Girl] in the "Guild Union".

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You're here. I didn't expect you so soon...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Do you remember the Drifting City you visited?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I still remember. My promise to give the future a happy ending is still a work in progress...)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: What are you thinking about...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, sorry. My mind wandered... Has something happened in the Drifting City?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Ambrosia is looking for you. I don't know the details, but I think it's about her sister.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anise?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Yes, you know her. Visit Ambrosia when you have time.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You know where to find her?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sunbathing on the roof, probably?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It is her hobby. I hope it's nothing serious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Jade.

steps.name: Traces of a Rift (2)
steps.objective: Obtain <Kei's Special Rice Bowl> and a <Durian Smoothie>, then find [Anise] in the "Drifting City".

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Yahoo! Welcome! I've heard the news, Goddess's Executioner!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's reached Freios, too...?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Don't despair. That's not important now!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right. Jade said you were looking for me.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Bingo!

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: The Mongle Mongle Guild is formally commissioning the adventurer %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: An official request?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Complete Alliance requests, and you'll receive plenty of help later. The Goddess's Executioner probably has quite a high rank already, without knowing it.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: It'll be good for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I get it. But please stop saying Goddess's Executioner...

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Trust me, and I'll give you a proper job. Something only you can do, %s!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like I'm being tricked, but should I play along?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you need?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: You know my sister? Anise was supposed to visit on leave, but something happened in the Drifting City.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Her big sister waited so long. Hmph.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Anyway, I want to go see her myself, but as guild master, I can't leave.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: And unless you're special, you can't stay there long. Apparently, the Goddess's Executioner %s will be fine...

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Deliver traditional Elias food to the Drifting City.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Food delivery?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Anise and Muller want to try some foreign cuisine. I'd like you to get it and take it to them, %s!

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Hehe. You'll do it, right?

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: (Ambrosia gazes at you with sparkling eyes, bright as stars in the night sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Hehe...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A-all right. I'll do it. But I expect proper payment! And stop calling me Goddess's Executioner!

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Yahoo! Wonderful! I'll give you the best food container, so fetch the food and deliver it. Understood, Delivery Executioner?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Why another Executioner? Fine, fine. I'll deliver it and come straight back. I have plenty to do.

lines.speaker: 암브로시아
lines.text: Thank you! I'll put in a good word with Narsha and the President.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The President? Narsha?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'll think about it after the trip. Back to the Drifting City...)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Hello, %s! It's been a while! But that smell...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ambrosia asked me to bring traditional Elias food!

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Thank you! I was hungry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good. Enjoy it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The lonely Drifting City comes into view, bringing memories of what happened here.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I haven't lost my memories of this place.)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Is my sister, Ambrosia, well? She must be, sending this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She's doing something on the roof, though I don't know what. She said she'd put in a good word with Narsha and the President when this job is done.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Oh, the President... Ah, Narsha... Ahahaha. I feel bad. I should have come along sooner. I hope she's not still sulking.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I'm a little frazzled. Phew... Things have been busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Muller looks too busy even to eat.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I'm only eating because I found a brief break...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's happened?

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: You helped before, so you know this city is full of things to study. We must investigate its condition and consider what to do for the future.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Recently, strange things began appearing all over the city. How should I describe them? Black holes.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: They felt like doors to another world. Neither Muller nor I could handle them, so we were searching for a solution.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: And then you arrived!

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: (Anise gazes at you with sparkling eyes, radiant as a star in the dawn sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you need me to do?

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I haven't even asked yet, and you're helping! Thank you so much!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then explain it.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Well, we'd like an expert opinion. I thought you might know someone familiar with such situations, %s.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Just waiting for the empire's help makes me uneasy... And some people in the council don't approve...

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: So I'd like your help, %s! My sister already said it, but I'll put in a good word with Narsha and the President, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone comes to mind... I'll visit them, then we can talk.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Thank you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Would Sarasvati know?)

steps.name: Traces of a Rift (4)
steps.objective: Obtain an <Abyssal Flame> in the "Abyss Chamber" and <Windy Seed's Barrier Fragment> in the "Magic Academy Main Building", then deliver them to [Sarasvati] in "Isolation Room 3".

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It's been a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you been well?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Nothing unusual. Since you've come, %s, I have some idea why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain the strange phenomena in the Drifting City.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The place where you experienced another realm of time. I cannot sense that city's other dimension.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I restructured the Hyperspace Network's data to verify it, with the same result.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Strange phenomena in the Drifting City...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The Great Wall, which prevents interference between dimensions, is probably shaking. As though someone is shaking it deliberately...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The person you sought gaining divine power has had some influence as well, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this another of the strange phenomena caused when Iris's power ran wild?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The data does not establish that precisely. Only that it was affected...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: %s, bring me objects from another world. I'll analyze them and give you an answer. Is that acceptable?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Among places you've visited recently, have you strongly sensed traces of the Demon Realm anywhere?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Abyss Chamber and Xerenis Magic Academy...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Outputting data. Abyssal Flame. Windy Seed Barrier Fragment...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Please bring those objects.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I'll return quickly.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: They are objects of another dimension. Please exercise great care.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You're back. Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Here are the items...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Beginning analysis immediately. However...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong? Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: An error has occurred. As expected, their composition differs from this planet's objects. Another method is required.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should we do? Should I bring something else?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: No. It's all right. You needn't worry.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: (The blue holographic keyboard before Sarasvati disappears, replaced by a red one.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Opening a new protocol not used in standard network mode. Mantra...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: (Sarasvati stares at a floating screen, hands moving rapidly.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Analysis complete. The objects you brought were consumed in the process.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you explain now?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes. Both objects were affected by Demon Realm energy.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The Abyssal Flame seems to have appeared after the Demon Realm was cut off from the Abyss Chamber. An external force also shattered the Windy Seed's barrier.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Someone appears to have used a rift in spacetime to wield part of the Demon Realm's power. Does anyone come to mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someone does, but I'm not certain...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... I'm not sure. You're the whole Hyperspace Network. Can't you tell?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Hmm... How should I explain...?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You know several timelines tied to this star's fate. It began in the city where you met another version of her.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I cannot discuss it, but some times and spaces defy Asgard's science. The Demon Realm in particular...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Beyond that, your appearance was a variable for everyone. For the Hyperspace Network, and for others targeting this place...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Whenever you resolved something somewhere, the network produced minor errors.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: But I opened a new protocol and updated the data, minimizing them. This applied only to you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's difficult to understand.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: What I can say for certain is that you're shaping a better future for this star.

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Yoo-hoo, Sarasvati! Praise your big sister like that, too! I want praise! Sarasvati! Sara...!

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: (Sarasvati frowns, and Freya's image vanishes.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: No noisy sisters, please. I dislike interruptions. Block complete...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It's been so long since she appeared, and she gets blocked like that... I almost feel sorry for her...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: She always finds a way through the block. In any case, the trouble in the city is resolved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? How? So quickly?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: During analysis, I broke down part of the objects and sent it into the rifts. The city's phenomena should stop for a while.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This is temporary. Even the Hyperspace Network cannot intervene in every timeline of this world. You must...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I know what you're going to say. Thank you, Sarasvati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Tell the people in that city it is resolved. Thanks to you, I collected a great deal of data.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll go tell them.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: We'll both be busy for a while. The adventurer and I...

lines.speaker: 프레이아
lines.text: Sarasvati, praise your big sister! I want praise! Sarasvati! Sara...!

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Adventurer! Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: The holes in the city disappeared! How did you do it?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, good. Their science really is incredible.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: You mean Asgard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Those people really are different. They even visited the imperial workshops to share scientific and technical knowledge.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Their way of thinking seems on another level from people in Freios.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Thank you. Now we can focus on research. And I can finally take my overdue leave and visit my sister! Ta-da! ☆

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I want a break, too...)

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: I'll meet Narsha and do all sorts of things. All thanks to you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Twins really are twins. Even their mannerisms match.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Since this is Guild Alliance business, I'll report properly to President Dayna. See you again.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Forgive the late greeting, %s... I thank you on behalf of the empire.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. See you both again, Anise, Muller.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: ...Ah, already gone. I had something to say...

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Anise.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Oh, Muller. What did the imperial council say?

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Nothing much. They still seem keen to halt our work here.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Hehe. Then we can just keep doing what we always do.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Well, yes... But since President Dayna came up, does the adventurer qualify now?

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: To enter the Guild Alliance city...

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: The President probably knows, doesn't she? All I can do is report.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Oh, Muller! What will you do on leave? Don't you need to see Lena?

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Lena will likely be busy for a while. She's an important talent, needed in many places.

lines.speaker: 아니스
lines.text: Of course! She's amazing. I'll tidy up and go see my sister. Take care of things while I'm gone, Muller!

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Of course. Enjoy yourself.

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: Sigh... The daughter of House Highren can take care of herself, surely?

lines.speaker: 뮐러
lines.text: What awaits an adventurer connected to those three sisters is plain enough...
